students.title: Students
students.subtitle: Manage student accounts and enrollment profiles.
students.name: Full name
students.passwordHint: Leave blank to keep the current password.

hints.name: Required. The student's full legal name, as it should appear on official documents.
hints.email: Required. Used to sign in and must be unique — no two accounts can share an email.
hints.username: Required. Used to sign in alongside the email, and must also be unique.
hints.password: Required. At least 8 characters. The student can change it later from their account.
hints.passwordHint: Optional. Leave empty to keep the current password — fill it in only to set a new one.
hints.gender: Required. Used for record-keeping and to route the student to gender-specific facilities where applicable.
hints.birthDate: Optional. Used to calculate age and verify eligibility for the selected grade level.
hints.nationalId: Required only if available, according to school policy. Used for official identification.
hints.phone: Optional. A direct contact number for the student, if they have one.
hints.active: Controls sign-in access. Turn off to block the student from logging in without archiving their record.
hints.academicYear: Required. The academic year this student is enrolling in — determines which classes are available below.
hints.currentClass: Optional until the student is assigned to a classroom. Only classes from the selected academic year are shown.
hints.admissionDate: Required. The date the student officially joined the school.
hints.admissionNumber: Optional. Leave empty to generate one automatically based on the academic year.
hints.rollNumber: Optional. An internal roll or seat number used for classroom attendance lists.
hints.scholarshipPercentage: Optional. The percentage discount applied to this student's fees, from 0 to 100.
hints.isGraduated: Marks the student as having completed their studies. Leave off for currently enrolled students.
hints.fatherName: Optional. Used for correspondence and emergency contact purposes.
hints.fatherPhone: Optional. A direct number to reach the student's father.
hints.motherName: Optional. Used for correspondence and emergency contact purposes.
hints.motherPhone: Optional. A direct number to reach the student's mother.
hints.guardianName: Optional. Fill in if someone other than the parents is the primary guardian.
hints.guardianPhone: Optional. A direct number to reach the guardian.
hints.guardianRelation: Optional. How the guardian is related to the student, e.g. uncle, grandparent.
hints.address: Optional. The student's home address, for correspondence and records.
hints.city: Optional. The city the student resides in.
hints.bloodGroup: Optional. Recorded for medical emergencies only.
hints.allergies: Optional but recommended. List any known allergies staff should be aware of.
hints.medicalConditions: Optional but recommended. Any medical conditions relevant to the student's care at school.
hints.previousSchool: Optional. The name of the school the student previously attended, if any.
hints.emergencyContactName: Recommended. Who to contact first in a medical or safety emergency.
hints.emergencyContactPhone: Recommended. A reachable number for the emergency contact.
hints.emergencyContactRelation: Optional. How the emergency contact is related to the student.

classes.title: Classes
classes.subtitle: Manage school classes and their sections.
classes.name: Class name
classes.search: Search by name or section code
classes.empty: No classes yet. Create the first one to get started.
classes.confirmArchive: Archive this class? It can be restored later by an administrator.
classes.noStudents: No students enrolled in this class yet.

hints.name: Required. The class's display name, e.g. "Grade 3" or "Science A".
hints.sectionCode: Required. A short code identifying the section, e.g. "A" or "1". Must be unique within the same academic year and grade level.
hints.capacity: Required. The maximum number of students this class can hold. Must be at least 1.
hints.academicYear: Required. The academic year this class belongs to — determines which section codes are available.
hints.gradeLevel: Required. The grade level this class teaches.
hints.branch: Required. The school branch this class is held at — determines which classrooms are available below.
hints.classroom: Optional. The physical classroom assigned to this class. Only classrooms from the selected branch are shown.
hints.classTeacher: Optional. The teacher primarily responsible for this class.
hints.assistantTeacher: Optional. A secondary teacher supporting the class teacher.
hints.active: Controls whether the class is available for new enrollments. Turn off to hide it without archiving.
